ad_info.reference_style: Bold centered typographic ad: a giant '3 EN 1' in the foreground across the lower half, the real bottle rising from behind it on a black background, two aguaje fruits at one side

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF. Secondary colors for this variation: deep black #0A0A0C (background) and aguaje amber #D9822B (the cut fruit flesh).
global_identity.visual_style: Bold, minimal, typographic supplement ad with the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Confident and dramatic but clean, studio light.
global_identity.graphic_language: Solid black background with a very soft, low-intensity fuchsia light behind the bottle, one giant number, one small rounded pill. No sparkles, flares, particles or extra shapes.
global_identity.text_typography: Giant number and lead-in in Montserrat ExtraBold; explanation and seal in Inter (Medium / SemiBold). Maximum three text levels.

creative_objective: Answer 'does it really work?' with a clear, complete formula instead of a promise: three plants and two vitamins in one bottle, said with one giant figure the eye reads in a fraction of a second.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The giant '3 EN 1' in the foreground. 2) The bottle rising from behind it. 3) The explanation line under the number. 4) The lead-in at the top. 5) The small registration pill.
art_direction.composition_style: Centered, symmetrical, three depth planes: background, bottle, number. The giant number crosses almost the full width of the lower half in FRONT of the bottle, hiding only its pink base band (never the label). Two small whole aguaje fruits and one cut half rest at the lower left, beside the number's left end, small and secondary. Reads top to bottom as one sentence: lead-in, bottle, number, explanation.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Lead-in y 5-9%, centered. Bottle centered, x 33-67% and y 12-66%, its top 80% visible above the number. Giant number centered within x 8-92%, baseline at about y 81%, top at about y 52%. Explanation y 84-90%, centered, max 2 lines. Registration pill centered at y 92.5-96.5%. Aguaje fruits x 4-22%, y 60-80%, behind the number's left edge plane. Side margins 5%.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Solid black background with a very soft, low-intensity fuchsia radial light behind the bottle (upper center) and a subtle vignette; no flares, no sparkles. Crisp studio key light from the upper left on the bottle with a thin white rim light. The number is flat crisp type casting a short soft shadow (about 25% opacity) onto the bottle where they overlap.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a solid black background and a very soft fuchsia light behind the center. A short all-caps lead-in centered at the top. The real bottle stands centered, large, rising from behind a giant ultra-bold '3 EN 1' in hot fuchsia that runs across the lower half in front of the bottle's base. Two small aguaje fruits and a cut half rest at the lower left. A one- or two-line explanation centered under the number and a small registration pill at the very bottom. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Opens the sentence the number completes
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Short all-caps line in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, 1 line, centered.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Centered, x 33-67% and y 12-66%, base hidden behind the number
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows what the number belongs to
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: The real bottle exactly as in the attached product photo, front view, about 52% of the canvas height, the whole label (including the three ingredient boxes) visible above the number's top edge; only the pink base band hides behind the number.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Centered within x 8-92%, baseline at about y 81%, top at about y 52%, in front of the bottle's base
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Stops the scroll with the formula fact
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: '3 EN 1' in ultra-bold condensed type: the '3' and the '1' in hot fuchsia #E6177F, 'EN' in white at about 60% of the digit size. Fully legible, no character hidden or cut.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the star ingredient as a real fruit, secondary
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Two whole aguaje palm fruits (egg-sized ovals with glossy reddish-brown scaly skin like snake scales) and one cut half showing orange-amber #D9822B flesh, small, sharp, soft contact shadows. They never touch the number's characters or the bottle.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Completes the sentence and names the formula
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One or two centered white lines at about 85% opacity, with a middle dot separator.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Trust: the sanitary registration given by the brand
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small rounded pill in pale blush pink #FBE3EE with dark plum text. Text only, no logos.

forbidden_additions: Charts, graphs, progress bars or infographics
Secondary numbers or a stats grid
Boxes, badges, divider bars or circles around the number
Pedestals, podiums or props other than the aguaje fruits
Leaves, plants, powders or other ingredients
Any trust seal other than the single registration pill
Logos or brand marks outside the bottle label
Decorative particles, sparkles, flares, confetti or extra shapes

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 bold centered typographic supplement ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Solid deep black #0A0A0C background with a very soft, low-intensity hot-fuchsia radial light behind the bottle in the upper center and a subtle vignette; no sparkles, no flares, no particles. Top center (y 5-9%) one short all-caps lead-in line in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, Montserrat ExtraBold, wide letter spacing. Centered (x 33-67%, y 12-66%) the real product standing upright, front view, about 52% of the canvas height, crisp studio key light from the upper left and a thin white rim light: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern, solid hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS'. In front of the bottle's base, across the lower half (centered within x 8-92%, baseline at about y 81%, top at about y 52%) a giant ultra-bold condensed '3 EN 1': the '3' and the '1' in hot fuchsia #E6177F and 'EN' in white at about 60% of the digit size, casting a short soft shadow onto the bottle; it hides only the pink base band, never the label. Lower left (x 4-22%, y 60-80%) two small whole aguaje palm fruits with glossy reddish-brown scaly skin and one cut half showing orange-amber flesh, sharp, with soft contact shadows. Under the number (y 84-90%) a centered white explanation line in Inter Medium at about 85% opacity, max 2 lines. Bottom center (y 92.5-96.5%) a small rounded pale blush pink pill with dark plum text. Clean, minimal, everything readable on a phone. No people, no other elements.

The real bottle, centered and rising from behind the number, label fully visible
Solid black background with a very soft fuchsia light behind the bottle
Two small aguaje fruits and one cut half at the lower left
Small pale blush registration pill at the bottom center
final_generation_exclusions: The number must never cover the bottle's label or the ingredient boxes.
No sparkles, flares, glitter, smoke or particles.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
